===
name: MENDEN-WEBAPP

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    tags-ignore:
      - '**'
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - '.github/workflows/web-app.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - '.github/workflows/web-app.yml'

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: write
  packages: write
  pull-requests: read
  id-token: write

env:
  APP_NAME: menden-web-app
  RELEASE_NAME: menden-app
  RELEASE_NAMESPACE: menden
  WORKING_DIRECTORY: app
  NODE_VERSION: "22.23.2"

jobs:
  prestart:
    runs-on:
      - runs-on=${{ github.run_id }}
      - runner=2cpu-linux-x64
    outputs:
      pull_request_state: ${{ steps.find_pull_request.outputs.state }}
      pull_request_number: ${{ steps.find_pull_request.outputs.number }}
      pull_request_base_ref: ${{ steps.find_pull_request.outputs.base-ref }}
      branch_name: ${{ steps.extract_branch.outputs.branch }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.extract_sha.outputs.sha_short }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract branch name
        id: extract_branch
        shell: bash
        run: echo "branch=${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Extract commit SHA
        id: extract_sha
        run: echo "sha_short=$(git rev-parse --short ${{ github.sha }})" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Find Pull Request
        uses: juliangruber/find-pull-request-action@v1
        id: find_pull_request
        with:
          branch: ${{ steps.extract_branch.outputs.branch }}
          state: open

  lint-and-tests:
    env:
      NODE_AUTH_TOKEN:  ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    needs: prestart
    runs-on:
      - runs-on=${{ github.run_id }}
      - runner=2cpu-linux-x64
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIRECTORY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        name: Install pnpm
        with:
